summary: Franco-Nevada, via an Australian subsidiary, agreed to acquire an additional A$170M (~$122M) gross royalty from Minerals 260 for the Bullabulling Gold Project, lifting its gross royalty from 2.45% to 3.90%, plus subscribe A$30M (~$22M) of Minerals 260 shares as lead order in a future equity raise, totaling A$200M. This follows a February 2026 A$220M package, bringing aggregate support to A$420M. Bullabulling hosts 4.4 Moz Indicated and 1.7 Moz Inferred resources; DFS and final investment decision expected early 2027, first gold potentially H2 2028. Watch resource conversion, equity raise terms and dilution.
